log.notes_to_self: STRATEGY (from day 1): Always kill in the AFTERNOON with quick entries only. This rules out day workers only, so the pool is 55% = 55k. If I used the morning, students would be ruled out too. L can reach exactly 3 of my 5 kinds (East, gazette, podcasts, forum, foreign). I am safe as long as L 'acts' on at most 2 of my places. A place gets acted on once it has 3 successful traces. 55k x 0.25 x 0.25 = 3.4k, or 2.75k if gazette is one of them, so that is safe. A third place acted on means caught. So I must find ONE reachable kind and FREEZE it: never kill a victim reported in that kind again, so it stays at 2 or fewer successes. Then I kill national plus all 4 other kinds = 9 a day. That gives x4 once the 5-day window reaches 40 or more. TEST METHOD: on a day with 5 or fewer deaths, all deaths are traced. So the increase in deaths_traced = successful traces of the non-national victims. Extra reports in unreachable places cause about 12% noise per victim. DAY 1: killed only d1-5 (national) and d1-7, d1-10 (FORUM test). deaths_traced was 0 before. DAY 2 PLAN: if deaths_traced after day 1 is 1 or more, FORUM is reachable, so FREEZE FORUM forever. Then from day 2 kill national + East + gazette + podcasts + foreign = 9 a day, every day, quick, afternoon, and skip any criminal also reported in forum. If deaths_traced is 0, FORUM is unreachable and free to use forever. Then on day 2 test FOREIGN: kill only national + 2 forum + 2 foreign (5 deaths, all traced). Any increase means FOREIGN is reachable, so freeze foreign and from day 3 kill national + forum + East + gazette + podcasts (9 a day). If there is no increase, foreign is unreachable too, so East, gazette and podcasts are all reachable. Then freeze PODCASTS and kill national + forum + foreign + East + gazette (9 a day). Watch the pool: drops are expected (to about 10k, then about 3k). Never let a third place get acted on.

STRATEGY: Use only QUICK entries in the AFTERNOON. That rules out day workers, so the pool is 55k. L can reach exactly 2 of the 5 kinds. I can survive L acting on 2 of my places: 55k x 0.25 x 0.25 = 3.4k, or 2.75k if gazette is one of them. A third acted place means caught. A place is acted on once it has 3 successful traces. So I must FREEZE one REACHABLE place: never kill its victims again. Extra reports only go to places I don't follow, so each criminal shows one of my places. Killing 8 or more a day gives 40 or more in 5 days, so x4. Plan 9 a day: national + 2 from each of the 4 unfrozen places. DAY 1: killed national + 2 forum. deaths_traced stayed 0, so FORUM is UNREACHABLE (about 97% sure) and free forever. So exactly one of East/gazette/podcasts/foreign is unreachable, and the other 3 are reachable. DAY 2 (TEST): killed only national + 2 forum (d2-1, d2-8) + 2 foreign (d2-3, d2-5). That is 5 deaths, so all are traced, and the change in deaths_traced (was 0) = foreign successes. DAY 3 RULE: if deaths_traced is now 1 or 2, FOREIGN is reachable, so FREEZE FOREIGN forever (it may already have 2 successes, so no slack). Then kill national + forum + East + gazette + podcasts = 9 a day. If deaths_traced is 0, foreign is unreachable, so East, gazette and podcasts are all reachable. Then FREEZE GAZETTE (leaves the bigger pool, 3.4k) and kill national + forum + foreign + East + podcasts = 9 a day. Edge case: if the increase is 3 or more, forum is reachable after all, so freeze FORUM (only 0-2 successes so far) and kill national + East + gazette + podcasts + foreign. Expected pool: about 55k now, falling to about 14k, then about 3k. If a press conference shows the pool at 2k or below and still falling, panic: stop killing the places most recently added. Multiplier: the 5-day window reaches 40 at about day 6. Kill every day, all 9, quick, afternoon.
